purpose: Inspect BLACK user-space Node/npm/npx installation and isolate which executable or path is unhealthy. Read-only.
command:
set -u
echo '===PATH==='
printf '%s\n' "$PATH"
echo '===COMMANDS==='
command -v node || true
command -v npm || true
command -v npx || true
echo '===LOCAL_BIN==='
ls -la "$HOME/.local/bin" 2>&1 || true
echo '===NODE_OPT==='
find "$HOME/.local/opt" -maxdepth 3 -type f -o -type l 2>/dev/null | head -120
echo '===LINK_TARGETS==='
for x in node npm npx; do
  p="$HOME/.local/bin/$x"
  printf '%s -> ' "$p"
  readlink -f "$p" 2>/dev/null || echo MISSING
done
echo '===BOUNDED_EXEC==='
for x in node npm npx; do
  echo "---$x---"
  command -v "$x" || true
  timeout 5s "$x" --version 2>&1; echo "rc=$?"
done
echo '===DONE==='
